what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in Austria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 177 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in Austria, 0.6% of all refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France hosts the most refugees from Serbia and Kosovo, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999.
It also records armed conflicts over Croatia territory in 1991 and 1992 and over Slovenia territory in 1991.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at its highest figure, 42918 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 and 1993, and the figure has fallen since.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Austria.
These are year-end totals for Austria only, reported to UNHCR.
